request: How is the Highway Trust Fund financed, and when is it projected to run short of money?

reply.reply:
The Highway Trust Fund is financed primarily by federal fuel taxes and truck-related taxes. Under CBO’s current-trends projection, the Mass Transit Account balance approaches zero in FY2027 and the Highway Account in FY2028 (CRS R48948, PDF p. 7). The fuel-tax sources include gasoline and diesel taxes, alternative-fuel taxes, and taxes on heavy truck tires, truck/trailer sales, and heavy vehicle use (CRS R47573, PDF p. 13). Congress has also used general-fund transfers to fill funding gaps (CRS R47573, PDF p. 7). These are projections, not guaranteed dates; the HTF cannot incur a negative balance.
